g.text: The frozen 1% selections retain all five memory coordinates (r = 5): a full control, with no compression.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #415765

g.text: Finite-grid diagnostics: 1,800 held-out spectral points and 261 evolution points. All r = 5 controls have relative errors < 10⁻¹³.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #415765

g.text: Bases were frozen using 183 training spectral points. Errors are relative Frobenius norms; this establishes no physical clock or global approximation bound.
